filterNotes: Dropped: Slither incorrect-exp HIGH (false positive in OZ Math.mulDiv, out-of-scope lib), all divide-before-multiply (OZ libs), timestamp (informational/QA), missing-zero-check, too-many-digits, missing-inheritance (QA). Aderyn centralization-risk, costly-loop, modifier-used-only-once, push-zero, state-no-address-check, unspecific-pragma (QA/by-design centralization). All 47 Semgrep findings are INFO-tier gas/style rules (use-custom-error, prefix-increment, ownable2step, short-revert-string, non-payable-constructor, array-length-caching, unchecked-arithmetic-in-loop, nested-if) - discarded.

findings.description: State writes (pool.totalStaked, user.amount, user.rewardDebt) occur after external calls to phUSD.mint (_settle) and strategy.deposit (_routeDeposit); poolInfo/userInfo reachable in cross-function reentrancy. No nonReentrant guard observed on this path.

State writes (pool.totalStaked, info.amount, info.rewardDebt) occur after external calls to phUSD.mint (_settle) and strategy.deposit (_routeDeposit). Migrator-only entry point but reuses the same accounting-after-call pattern; cross-function read via pendingReward/_updatePool.

migrationInfo[token] and yieldStrategy[token] are written after external call R = _routeExit (strategy.withdraw). Aderyn flags the same site (line 391). Realized-amount snapshot (R) is captured from the external call and stored as migration state; cross-function reentrancy via _updatePool/pendingReward/setYieldStrategy.

Local variables 'total' (line 64) and 'migratedCount' (line 75) are never explicitly initialized. Defaults to 0; flagged by both tools. Confirm intended as zero-accumulators in the migration loop and not a logic gap in the Migrated event totals.
Local variable 'total' (line 438) never explicitly initialized before use in the batch-migrate accumulation loop.

Return value of EnumerableSet add/remove ignored at lines 253 (stake add), 273 (withdraw remove), 313 (emergencyWithdraw remove), 476 (_exitPosition remove), 534 (depositFor add). Bool return indicates set membership change; ignoring it can mask double-add/missing-remove staker-set bookkeeping errors (e.g. staker re-added or not removed at zero balance).

External calls inside loops: StableStaker._exitPosition mints phUSD.mint(account, pending) per staker (line 479) under batchMigrate; StableStakerMigrator.migrate calls newStaker.depositFor per user (StableStakerMigrator.sol:78). Unbounded staker arrays => DoS-by-gas / partial-migration risk on large pools.
